title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning (Gu, Kelly & Xiu)
signal_frequency: monthly forecast and rebalance; annual model refit
data_requirements: point-in-time panel of stock characteristics (94 in the source)
aggregate time-series conditioning variables for interactions
a long history - the protocol needs train, validation AND test windows

sources.citation: Gu, S., Kelly, B., & Xiu, D. (2020). Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning. The Review of Financial Studies, 33(5), 2223-2273.

Harvey, C. R., Liu, Y., & Zhu, H. (2016). ... and the Cross-Section of Expected Returns. Review of Financial Studies, 29(1), 5-68. (The multiple-testing critique applying to the input characteristics.)
